sentences.en: It’s important to instil good habits in children early on.
sentences.zh: 重要的是要从小在孩子身上灌输好习惯。

sentences.en: The teacher tried to instil a love for reading in her students.
sentences.zh: 老师试图让学生爱上阅读。

sentences.en: Her parents worked hard to instil the value of perseverance in her.
sentences.zh: 她的父母努力让她明白坚持不懈的价值。
